label: Updated at 12 p.m. ET
title: Today In Golf
summary: A 30-second briefing on today's biggest golf stories.

items.headline: Patrick Reed Injury Setback
items.text: Patrick Reed withdrew from the Alfred Dunhill Links Championship due to a wrist injury, risking his $2 million Race to Dubai bonus and opening the door for Rory McIlroy to close a 308-point lead.

items.headline: Tommy Fleetwood Withdraws Sick
items.text: Tommy Fleetwood apologized to fans after abruptly withdrawing amid illness following missed cut struggles at the BMW PGA Championship and Open de France.

items.headline: Scottie Scheffler Revisits 2024 Incident
items.text: Scottie Scheffler reflected on being detained outside Valhalla Golf Club before the 2024 PGA Championship second round, sharing his perspective on the event.
